title: olc5.12 S4 residual: cascaded grant endings anchor the cooldown at the clock, not the cascade event time
description: Within a single advanceWorldTime, a grant ended by a cascade (e.g. concentration broken when an owner is removed by another expiry) schedules its grant-ended cooldown from the advance endpoint, not the cascade's event minute. Needs an event time threaded through cleanup/cascade contexts. Sol S4 required closure, partially met (direct expiry and explicit end are exact).
